from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named participant in the case with their procedural role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the person or entity")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The procedural role (e.g. '上诉人', '被上诉人', '再审申请人')")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A fee or cost mentioned in the judgment, including amount and bearer."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The fee amount and currency/unit (e.g. '4040 元')")
    bearer: str | None = Field(description="Who is ordered to pay or the party bearing the cost")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of fee (e.g. '二审案件受理费', '一审案件受理费')")

class AssetSplit(BaseModel):
    """Details of a specific asset division mentioned in the judgment."""
    asset_name: str | None = Field(description="The name or description of the asset (e.g. '存款', '林权证')")
    total_amount: str | None = Field(description="The total value or principal if specified")
    allocation: str | None = Field(description="How the asset is split among parties (e.g. '张某分得 25600.85 元，赵某 1 分得 8533.62 元')")

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A summary of one judgment document extracted for matching purposes."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number (e.g. '(2023) 辽 0522 民初 2512 号')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g. '二审民事判决书', '再审审查裁定书')")
    dispute_type: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (e.g. '离婚财产纠纷', '继承纠纷')")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of named parties with roles")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core holding text (e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="All fees mentioned with amounts and bearers")
    asset_splits: list[AssetSplit] = Field(description="Details of specific asset divisions")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the record")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_records: list[JudgmentRecord]
